units.title: mit12_340s12_ps1
examples: carbon-isotope mass balance for the PETM: carbon added from volcanoes or methane for a −3 ‰ shift
read ice and sediment core temperature series: warmer-than-today intervals, how fast climate changes, regional against global
why δ18O of foraminifera and of ice move opposite ways over glacial cycles

units.title: mit12_340s12_ps2
examples: derive Wien's law and the Stefan–Boltzmann constant from Planck's law
surface temperature of three planets: bare rock, one opaque layer, one leaky layer; absorptivity for 288 K

units.title: mit12_340s12_ps4
examples: global warming potential over 20, 100 and 500 years of a gas with a given half-life and absorption

units.title: mit12_340s12_ps5
examples: describe the three Milankovitch cycles; sum precession and obliquity sine terms on summer insolation at 60°N
percent rise in saturation vapour per 1 °C from Clausius–Clapeyron; forcing or feedback
surface irradiance change from aerosol optical depth (Beer's law); AOD to offset 2 W/m² of forcing
